Idle.1: I'm taking it easy for now. Let me know when there's work to do.
Idle.2: Everything's quiet today. That's not a bad thing.
Idle.3: I'll be here if you need an extra pair of hands.

WaterCrops.2: Watering is straightforward work, but it makes all the difference.
WaterCrops.3: I'll handle the dry crops. You can focus on the rest of the farm.
HarvestCrops.1: I'll gather anything that's ready and make sure the produce gets stored safely.
HarvestCrops.2: A ripe field doesn't stay ripe forever. I'll keep up with the harvest.
HarvestCrops.3: I'll bring in the crops as soon as they're ready.

TendCrops.2: Watering or harvesting, I'll keep the field moving along.
TendCrops.3: The crops are in good hands. I'll handle the daily work.

ChopHardwood.2: Hardwood takes more effort, but I'll bring back everything I can.

ExploreArea.1: I'll bring back what I find and send the haul to our storage.
